# TP65-Q29 · Do channel readings differ between look-ahead and landed forum sentences?

**1. Question and prediction.** Do channel readings differ between look-ahead and landed forum sentences? SADNESS was predicted higher on landed sentences. The six channel-specific timing predictions and the change-versus-neither comparison were registered before Q29.

**2. Source and size.** Class P. Held-out GoEmotions forum comments. ISEAR, publicly obtainable under noncommercial research terms. 17,122 sentences in 11,157 complete comments and 9,734 author clusters. 2 sentences from incomplete comments excluded.

Values are position-adjusted within-comment differences with 95% intervals from 2,000 whole-writer resamples. Counts and intervals come from the released table.

**4. Verdict.** **descriptive.** SADNESS ahead minus landed -0.05360327 [-0.1015039, -0.005287482] using B and 0.02959392 [-0.07389602, 0.09682334] on agreement.

**5. Limit.** All three B/W reliability checks were weak on this source-order prefix. These within-comment estimates are descriptive. ISEAR has no paired timing contrast, and Q29 has no sentence worry scores.

**6. Withholding and release.** ISEAR has 21,247 valid B marks and no W marks. Independent readings would be needed for a reliability-gated contrast. Q29 did not score worry.
